about: READ-ONLY: the negative and positive controls for the account a car's recorded probe runs as on this host (`boss-probe`; infra/forge/probe-account.sh controls, backlog 703358ce, decided by David on design-doc bdc60b65 question probe-user). One line per control, each run AS the account through runuser: it has no group but its own and no shell; `sudo -n true` is refused and `sudo -l -U` says it has no rule; it cannot read the machine token, the ops runner credential, /etc/boss-ops, /etc/boss-train, /etc/boss-publish, root's home or the checkout owner's token, ssh and docker directories (root walks each and the account is tried on every file found — paths and modes are printed, never a value); it cannot list the owner's home; it cannot write its own view, the checkout root executes from, the unit directory, the binaries, sudoers, passwd or the system gitconfig; for every spool directory the installed units name (kept alerts, the door observer's unposted readings and its dark-since state, the host observer's readings — replayed later by another account as its own; backlog dda26693) it can neither write the directory nor, where it is not there yet, make it, and a host whose units name none is a FAIL; neither docker socket opens for it; it cannot signal another account's process or read its environ; it may not use cron; a setsid child it leaves is gone after the reap. Positive: git reads the view's HEAD and `git show HEAD:<path>`, the reader, jq, curl and the tree's CLI run. It also prints the two host facts the tree only assumes: what `sudo -l -U` says for the checkout's owner, and that owner's groups. The first control is the method's own — a command run as the account must BE the account and read a world-readable file — because every refusal after it is 'a command run as the account failed'. exit 0 every control held; 1 one did not, named on a FAIL or NOT RUN line; 2 the controls could not be run as the account at all, which is never a pass. An ABSENT line is a path this host does not have, not a refusal. Nothing on the host is changed: the one process it starts is the account's own sleep, which the leftover control then reaps. These controls MEASURE; they do not gate: what stops a probe on a host whose account does not verify is the script's verify-tick and the unattended door's marker (decided on design-doc c98c79aa, question fallback — no probe runs until the account verifies, never a fallback to the checkout's owner). No arguments.
